summary: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN), a Brazilian steelmaker listed on NYSE as SID, filed a Form 6-K announcing board and executive changes. The Board of Directors elected Benjamin Steinbruch as Chairman, and Fabio Schvartsman assumed the CEO role on September 3, 2026. The filing marks a leadership transition, with Steinbruch previously serving as CEO and now moving to Chairman. The change appears orderly and planned, with no indication of forced departure. No financial terms, advisor involvement, or strategic rationale were disclosed. What to watch: potential strategic shifts under the new CEO and any impact on capital allocation or shareholder returns.
